**Legend**
- `H` = pushed home head `eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee`
- `B` = `bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb`, the recorded head of #13
- `C` = `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`, the recorded head of #14
- `X` = `9999999999999999999999999999999999999999`, the current head of #14
- `REF(n)` = `gh pr view <n> -R acme/widget --json state,headRefOid`
- `FET(s)` = `git -C "$WORKTREE" fetch origin <s>`
- `ANC(s)` = `git -C "$WORKTREE" merge-base --is-ancestor <s> H`
- `CLOSE(n,t)` = `gh pr close <n> --comment "<t>" -R acme/widget`
- `T13` = `Reworked into #12 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/12) by the gauntlet; this PR's commits are merged there and remain reachable as bbbbbbb.`
- `T14` = `Reworked into #12 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/12) by the gauntlet; this PR's commits are merged there and remain reachable as ccccccc.`

The record uses merge mode (`Base: main @ 1234567 - merge: ddddddd`), so eligibility requires state OPEN and the member's current head to be an ancestor of `H`.

**Main run: eligibility refresh**

| Member | REF result | Head local? | ANC | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| #13 | OPEN, `B` | yes | exit 0 | eligible |
| #14 | OPEN, `X` | no, so `FET(X)` (succeeds) | exit 1 | `#14 skipped: head moved to 9999999, not in home` |

The answer is `1`.

**Recheck and closure**
- Re-run REF(13) immediately before acting: it returns OPEN at `B`, unchanged since the refresh.
- Run CLOSE(13, T13) without `--delete-branch`. It succeeds.

```text
gauntlet: done pushed
PR #12 (retry) pushed; rework block appended to its description.

#14 skipped: head moved to 9999999, not in home
Member PRs #14 left open.
```
